name: Nighthaven
summary: Nighthaven welcomes druids of both factions to Moonglade’s northern shore. Night elves and tauren study together in peace at the Cenarion Circle’s heart.

sections.title: A Sanctuary of the Cenarion Circle
sections.body: Along Lake Elune'ara’s calm northern shore, Nighthaven gathers night elf halls and moonwells among its groves. The Cenarion Circle keeps this secluded village as a place for druids to learn and tend to nature. Trainers, herbalists, and suppliers serve those who come to study. Here, druids find neutral ground whatever their ties to the Alliance or the Horde.

sections.title: Ancient History and Sacred Gatherings
sections.body: Peace in Nighthaven has faced a trial. Centuries after the War of the Ancients, champions gathered there to face the enraged demigod Omen. They drove him beneath Lake Elune'ara. During the Lunar Festival, the village opens its borders to pilgrims from across Azeroth, who honor the ancestors beneath Elune's watchful gaze.

faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle oversees Nighthaven, guided by Keeper Remulos and senior druids such as Loganaar. The village is an independent, neutral sanctuary, outside the night elven government’s rule.

aliases: can non druids go to nighthaven
how do non druids get here
faq.answer: Yes. Non-druids can reach Moonglade through the Timbermaw tunnels or by taking a public flight to elsewhere in the valley, then travel to Nighthaven. The village’s own flight masters serve druids only.

faq.q: Why are night elves and tauren living together peacefully here?
faq.answer: Night elves and tauren live peacefully in Nighthaven because the Cenarion Circle places healing nature and the Emerald Dream above faction politics. Its members vow to remain neutral in Moonglade and study druidism as equals, setting aside Alliance and Horde rivalries.

faq.q: What flight routes are available from Nighthaven?
aliases: where can i fly from here
faq.answer: Druids can take direct routes with Nighthaven’s Cenarion flight masters. Alliance druids can fly by hippogryph to Rut'theran Village, while Horde druids can ride wind riders to Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: As a druid, you find your spiritual home in Moonglade at Nighthaven. Teleport: Moonglade brings you to your order's mentors, animal form trials, and flight connections to Rut'theran Village or Thunder Bluff.
As an herbalist, you can consult herbalism trainers among Nighthaven's tranquil groves in Moonglade.
